description: This file defines a report parser class for accounting indicators in an Odoo module, including methods for generating graphs, trees, and data arrays related to account reports.

classes.name: accounting_report_indicator
classes.description: A report parser class for generating accounting indicator reports, including methods for creating graphs, trees, and data arrays.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Generates a list of report lines with hierarchy levels and attributes.

methods.name: getarray_head
methods.description: Prepares header data for array representation of report data, including graph generation.

methods.name: getarray
methods.description: Returns data array for report, with headers and object name.

methods.name: gettree
methods.description: Creates a tree diagram image representing report hierarchy and returns its path.

methods.name: getgraph
methods.description: Generates a bar chart image based on report data and returns its path.
